integrity: The proof is exact and non-computational: it reduces the published affine-majorant infimum to a least-concave-majorant value and a two-point barycentric formula. Boundary cases for both canonical factors and the constant function were replayed symbolically. No independent validation or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result is a convex-geometric sharpening of the published two-factor C(K) norm formula, not a new free-product construction. It is limited to two C(K)-factors. Because least-concave-majorant duality is classical, an equivalent observation may exist under different terminology or may have been viewed as implicit despite targeted searches.
title: Two-slice norm formula for free products of \(C(K)\)-spaces
